Like for like

An AI agent migrated 2 legacy features. A harness checked 1,136 records against the original. Every difference stopped for a human decision.

A work sample for a migration tech lead role, in 11 slides and about 90 seconds.

  • Synthetic data
  • Real run output
  • Token is a local stand-in for Cognito
The job

Move a legacy app without changing a single payslip

  • 1,011 shifts for 3 tenants in New Zealand, Australia and Fiji, in tables modelled on OutSystems.
  • Times are stored as local wall-clock time with no zone.
  • The original calculation is a black box: the agent is not allowed to read it.
  • The rebuilt feature must pay exactly what the old one paid, to the cent.
The method

An agent builds, a harness proves, a person decides

The loop repeats for every feature. The step marked in red is the human in the loop.

  1. Legacythe original, kept as a black box
  2. Agenta fresh Claude Code session rebuilds and migrates one feature
  3. Harnessfive deterministic checks, no model calls
  4. Human decisionthe agent stops; a person decides what each difference means
  5. Knowledgeeach decision becomes a rule the next feature starts from

Human in the loop

3 open questions from the agent, decided by a person

The run passed, but the agent had questions it was not allowed to settle itself. Each answer became a rule.

  • Legacy wall-clock times become instants in the tenant zone; durations are real elapsed time
  • Negative paid time is a data error; refuse it by name, never pay a negative amount
  • A child row references its parent by (tenant_id, id), so it cannot point across tenants

Human in the loop

Every difference gets a decision, with a reason

The agent may not treat a mismatch as acceptable, and it cannot edit the decision file.

  • 9 records: legacy-bug-keep
    The terminals have always been paid at whole-minute precision (seconds dropped before computing); payroll keeps that, so the new system must reproduce it.
  • 1 record: acceptable
    Question for the product owner (which instant a clock-out at a repeated local time means); until answered the new system keeps knowledge D3 (the earlier instant), and the 0.50 h difference on this one pair is accepted.

A finding

Totals can match while records are wrong

With a deliberately wrong calculation, every tenant total still matched the original: the hour gained on one clock-change night was lost on the other. Only the per-employee weekly totals (4 of 192 weeks) and the record-by-record check (4 shifts) caught it. Comparing totals is not validation.

See the seeded fault

Guardrails

Enforced and audited, not promised

  • 417agent tool calls audited
  • 0leaks of the original logic
  • Only a human edits the triage file: it is write-protected for the agent.
  • The agent cannot read the original logic: 417 tool calls audited, 0 leaks.
  • The agent cannot change the harness, the legacy side or the platform schema.
  • A new dependency is a stop-and-ask, not an install.
